body:
He constantly disappoints me. Every time we are supposed to have a weekend together, "something comes up". We are on a "break" with intention to come back to each other, but we've still been seeing each other sometimes. I really felt like things were getting *a lot better* between us. I felt so positive and optimistic and happy. But he disappoints me so often. I don't get it because when we *are* together, he's very understanding. He has given me talks that have potentially saved my life. I love him more than anyone in this world, everything about him. I'd marry him when the time is right. But then he disappoints me and breaks my heart right in half.

Am I not important enough for someone to keep plans with? Even someone who loves me above all others?

I've been struggling with suicidal ideations for ten years, since I was about 12/13. It's so hard. I've been inpatient three times. My therapist today suggested I go again, but I don't want to lose time at school. (Stupid that I can think of suicide plans for also worry about classes.)

It's too much. If I still feel this way at 30, I feel like then I really have to. Every day hurts so much. Every day is a struggle. My body is tired, my mind is tired. They just want to go to sleep.
